data.title: Arabian Ranches III
data.about:
Say goodbye to the ordinary and embrace life at its best with just good vibes, pure fun, supreme comfort, and great convenience in a high-end community which you can call home in the desert metropolis. At Arabian Ranches 3 by Emaar, find your version of happiness with a myriad of exciting and amazing things to do, explore, and create. Come home to your paradise in Dubai.

Arabian Ranches 3 was first unveiled by Emaar in 2004. Since then, it has been developed into one of the grandest gated communities in the region. Here, you will feel like you are at the center of the world with more than 4,000 villas and townhouses as well as world-class amenities and facilities surrounding you.

An upscale choice of contemporary 3 & 4 bedroom townhouses await you at Sun at Arabian Ranches 3. Type 1 exudes a modern spirit that takes inspiration from the desert and reflects your refined style. Here, take delight in the beauty of earth tone colours that perfectly blend with the white paint. Type 2 is a contemporary, opulent abode featuring am exquisite collage of grays and whites where the architecture blends harmoniously with the lush street landscape.

  • Lush green landscapes
  • Experience the beauty of life to the fullest
  • The most prestigious address in Dubai
  • 3 & 4 bedroom luxury townhouses
  • 3 BR Starting at AED 1.2M only
  • Outstanding amenities

location_tile.title: At the centre of everything
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
At Arabian Ranches 3 in Dubai, you and your family in Dubai are in good hands. Here, every day is a delightful adventure with a wide spectrum of amenities, exclusive facilities, and fund activities that await you. What’s more, this paradise is strategically located between Sheikh Zayed bin Hamdan Al Nahyan St. and Emirates Road to give you easy access to key landmarks and destinations such as:

  • 05 minutes from Global Village
  • 10 minutes from Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club
  • 20 minutes from Downtown Dubai
  • 20 minutes from Dubai International Airport
  • 35 minutes from the Dubai Mall
  • 35 minutes from Dubai Marina
  • 35 minutes from Al Maktoum International Airport
